summary.title: Passenger Information System
summary.description: This is for passenger information system for Company ABC

threats.title: Controller Service is not available
threats.description: The controller is attacked through USB/Ethernet,  the resource is exhausted and cannot provide service.
threats.mitigation:
1. Limit the communication frequency with customer Local Center.
2. Limit USB HID enum
3. physical USB interface should be locked.
4. Limit the interface speed and broadcast for ethernet interface. IP whitelist

threats.title: Runtime Data disclosure
threats.description: The runtime data inside controller process maybe dumped, method like memory dump, ptrace, /proc system file, etc.
threats.mitigation:
1. system security. disable core dump in the system configuration, debug mode for the application.
2. privilege. startup the application with least privilege.
3. Security coding. credentials should be destroyed  after usage.

threats.title: Static data inside controller maybe disclosure
threats.description: The static data including application configurations, application logs and monitoring metrics  inside controller system maybe attacked and  disclosure.
threats.mitigation:
1. credentials cannot be included in application configuration files and should be saved in TPM if necessary.
2. application logs do NOT log credentials.

threats.title: Maintainer‘s login and operations should be saved
threats.description: Maintainers that login and operate the controllers may repudiate their behaviors.
threats.mitigation: Maintainers's activities who login and operation the system should be saved and auditable.

threats.title: Login through USB/Ethernet should be authnticated
threats.description: Attacker impersonated  the administrator to patch/operate the application and system through USB/Ethernet.
threats.mitigation: For USB/Ethernet, authentication for the login user should be considered. for example, username/password, hardware key, etc.

threats.title: Gain root or high privileges via USB debugging or malformed USB data.
threats.description: Gain root or high privileges via USB debugging or malformed USB data.
threats.mitigation: Disable unused debug interfaces; run services with least privilege.

threats.title: An attacker spoofs the identity of the local server to send fake commands to the PIS device.
threats.description: An attacker spoofs the identity of the local server to send fake commands to the PIS device.
threats.mitigation: Mutual TLS, device certificate authentication, and IP whitelisting between PIS and server.

threats.title: An attacker spoofs other in-vehicle devices (LED, audio/PA system) via industrial protocols
threats.description: An attacker spoofs other in-vehicle devices (LED, audio/PA system) via industrial protocols.
threats.mitigation: Authenticate industrial protocol communication; use secure protocol extensions or source validation.

threats.title: An attacker spoofs an administrator or maintenance user
threats.description: An attacker spoofs an administrator or maintenance user
threats.mitigation: Strong password, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and certificate-based login.

threats.title: Tamper with display content, voice broadcast, configuration, or emergency messages.
threats.description: Tamper with display content, voice broadcast, configuration, or emergency messages.
threats.mitigation: Sign and verify all control commands and configuration data.

threats.title: Malicious firmware or patch installation via Ethernet or USB.
threats.description: Malicious firmware or patch installation via Ethernet or USB.
threats.mitigation: Mandatory digital signature verification for firmware and patches; secure update mechanism.

threats.title: Tamper with industrial protocol data between PIS and in-vehicle devices.
threats.description: Tamper with industrial protocol data between PIS and in-vehicle devices.
threats.mitigation: Integrity check (checksum, HMAC, or encryption) for industrial communication.

threats.title: Tamper with system logs to cover attacks.
threats.description: Tamper with system logs to cover attacks.
threats.mitigation: Write-only log storage, remote log transmission, and log integrity protection.

threats.title: Have DDOS attack from controller and out of service
threats.description: Have DDOS attack from controller and out of service
threats.mitigation: authenticate controller

threats.description: Data inside MySQL may disclosure
threats.mitigation: Encrypted data at rest

threats.title: MySQL cannot provide service  because of resource
threats.description: MySQL cannot provide service  because of resource
threats.mitigation: Limit query rate; authenticate request

threats.title: Messages are tampered
threats.description: The messages could be tampered by the attackers and spread harmful information to the public
threats.mitigation: The messages and the channel should be encrypted.
